Pre-configured scenarios to get started quickly
At 23:30, turns on dark theme, Do Not Disturb, silent profile, and lowers screen brightness to 10%.
When charging and battery reaches 100%, announces via TTS, shows notification, and plays an alert sound.
Battery fully charged, please unplug the charger.
Battery has reached 100%. You can disconnect your charger.
When battery drops below 15% while unplugged, turns on Battery Saver, sets brightness to 15%, turns off Bluetooth, and enables dark theme.
When placed face down on a surface, turns on Do Not Disturb and gives a subtle confirmation pulse.
Shaking the phone turns the camera flashlight on or off, with double-tap vibration feedback.
When ambient light drops below 5 lux and screen is on, lowers brightness to 5% and enables dark theme.
When disconnected from home Wi-Fi, turns on mobile data, sets sound profile to normal, and raises volume to 80%.
When connected to home Wi-Fi, turns off mobile data for power saving and sets brightness to 50%.
When incoming SMS matches keyword, turns on GPS, waits 5 seconds for satellite lock, and replies with live Google Maps coordinates.
On weekdays between 05:00 and 10:00, unplugging the charger or turning the screen on turns off Do Not Disturb, restores normal sound, and sets brightness to 70%.
At 23:00 or when the screen turns off at night, turns on Do Not Disturb, silences the sound profile, and drops media volume to 20%.
Between 06:00 and 10:00, leaving home Wi-Fi or unplugging the charger turns on mobile data, restores normal sound, and sets media volume to 80%.
On weekdays at 09:00, when it is between 09:00 and 18:00 and you are not on home Wi-Fi, turns on Do Not Disturb and switches sound to vibrate.
When the screen turns on between 00:00 and 06:00 and the battery is below 60%, lowers brightness to 10% and enables dark theme.

Some actions require additional system permissions.
Tip: tap the status pill on an automation to jump here.
Required to detect when apps open. Open system Settings and allow FlowPilot.
Shows engine status while automation runs.
Required to detect incoming, answered, outgoing, and ended phone calls. FlowPilot never reads call log, never accesses contacts, and never records audio.
Required for the Call number automation action to place real telephone calls automatically without manual dialer confirmation.
Required for incoming SMS triggers to detect incoming messages, filter senders, match verification codes, and trigger automations.
Required for the Send SMS action to send automated background SMS text messages directly without manual app confirmation.
Allows FlowPilot to trigger automations when notifications arrive from selected apps.
Required on Android 12+ to list bonded devices and receive Bluetooth device connect/disconnect events. FlowPilot never runs Bluetooth discovery or stores paired-device history.
NFC hardware is not available on this device.
NFC is turned off in system settings. Turn on NFC to scan tags and trigger rules.
NFC hardware is active and ready for tag triggers.
Android requires ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION permission, Wi-Fi permissions, and device Location enabled to identify connected Wi-Fi SSID and scan nearby networks for Wi-Fi triggers and conditions.
FlowPilot needs foreground location permission first. Tap to grant location access.
Device GPS / Location service is turned off. Tap to open system Location settings and turn on Location.

Required so FlowPilot can read your GPS coordinates (${location.lat}, ${location.lng}) in the background (e.g. for incoming SMS triggers or automations when the screen is locked). Tap to select \'Allow all the time\' (Her zaman izin ver).
FlowPilot has full background GPS access. Automations can read ${location.lat} and ${location.lng} anytime, even when the screen is locked.
Allows FlowPilot to turn Do Not Disturb on or off. Grant Notification Policy Access in Android settings.
Allows FlowPilot to change system settings such as Auto-rotate. Grant in Android special access settings.
Allow FlowPilot to run without battery restrictions. Required for reliable schedules while screen is off.
HyperOS does not expose this setting for apps to read. Open list to verify FlowPilot is enabled, then set Battery saver to No restrictions.
Battery Saver actions can run through Shizuku. ADB grant is optional direct access.
Required for Battery Saver actions. Grant with ADB or Shizuku.
Required to toggle NFC and Bluetooth. Install, start, then grant access.

Connect the phone over USB with debugging enabled, then run:

adb shell pm grant %1$s android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS

Or start Shizuku, tap Setup here and FlowPilot grants it for you.
Allow all the time (Her zaman izin ver)

To send your GPS location while the app is in the background or screen is off, Android requires the 'Allow all the time' (Her zaman izin ver) permission.

1. Tap 'Open settings' below
2. Tap 'Permissions' > 'Location'
3. Select 'Allow all the time' (Her zaman izin ver)

Privacy-first, offline, and lightweight Android automation engine.
No telemetry or cloud sync. Automatic update checks contact GitHub only when enabled; disable them in Settings. Webhooks, SMS, and exports send only data you choose.
Event-driven architecture. Sensors and listeners activate only when matching rules require them.
Manage system-level toggles (Mobile Data, Airplane mode, GPS, Dark Mode) securely without root.
